<p class="page-lede">Every committee agenda filed this session, newest first. The next meeting for each committee is also shown on its [Committees](committees.qmd) tab.</p>

```{r}
library(gt)
source("scripts/shared.R")

# Agenda PDFs are named <committee>_<MM>_<DD>_<YY>.pdf, e.g. anr_10_17_25.pdf
pdf_files <- list.files(AGENDAS_DIR, pattern = "\\.pdf$")

if (length(pdf_files) == 0) {
  cat("Committee agendas have not been set.")
} else {
  agendas <- data.frame(filename = pdf_files) |>
    mutate(
      code  = str_extract(filename, "^[^_]+"),
      month = str_extract(filename, "(?<=_)\\d{2}(?=_\\d{2}_\\d{2})"),
      day   = str_extract(filename, "(?<=_\\d{2}_)\\d{2}(?=_\\d{2})"),
      year  = str_extract(filename, "(?<=_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_)\\d{2}"),
      date_obj = as.Date(paste0("20", year, "-", month, "-", day)),
      Meeting.Date = format(date_obj, "%m/%d/%y"),
      Agenda_Link = sprintf("[View Agenda](%s/%s)", AGENDAS_DIR, filename),
      Committee_Name = COMMITTEE_NAMES[code]
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(date_obj)) |>
    select(Meeting.Date, Committee_Name, Agenda_Link)

  agendas |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      Meeting.Date = "Meeting Date",
      Committee_Name = "Committee",
      Agenda_Link = "Agenda"
    ) |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = Agenda_Link) |>
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) |>
    opt_interactive(
      use_sorting = TRUE,
      use_filters = FALSE,
      use_resizers = TRUE,
      page_size_default = 20
    ) |>
    opt_row_striping()
}
```
